This '''unidentified captain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], this [[Captain/Legends|captain]] commanded a [[Unidentified escort frigate|frigate]] that was used as an escort for a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[drone freighter]]s en route to the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].
